title: Espionage: Codename Tian Du Chao Feng
author: Zhuan Sheng
synopsis:
Shen Zhizhen went to a tomb with her professor,
only to be killed by a group of grave robbers who suddenly broke into the chamber.
When she opened her eyes again, not only had she become the descendant of a grave robber,
but she had also been branded as a little traitor...
